common.tagline: All your links, strung together in one place — in every language.

home.heroTitle: One link in bio. Every language in the world.
home.heroSubtitle: Linketto is the multilingual “link in bio” page: your profile speaks every visitor’s language. Hosted in the EU, no commissions and honest prices.
home.featureLangBody: One page, many languages: visitors see your profile in their own language, automatically.
home.featureFeeBody: You sell through your own payment link (Revolut, PayPal and others) — the money goes straight to you, Linketto takes no cut. Your payment provider’s own fees still apply.
home.featureAnalyticsBody: We count clicks, not people. No personal data and no consent banner.
home.featureTrustBody: Transparent moderation with notice and the right to appeal. Never a shameful banner on your page.
home.featureEuBody: Hosted in the EU, GDPR by default. Payments (Revolut Bank UAB) and email (Brevo) are with EU providers; the only one outside the EU is AI (Google) — only when you use “Translate with AI” or “Generate bio” yourself. Details in the Privacy Policy.
home.featureDomainBody: Custom domains on paid plans — your reputation never depends on someone else's abuse.
home.featureAiBody: Write in your language — Linketto translates your profile into all the others with one button.
home.featureQrBody: A QR code in your color and a vCard block that saves your contact to any phone with one tap.
home.heroBadge: Multilingual link in bio · EU hosted
home.manifestoQuote: We will never show “BANNED” to your visitors. We moderate transparently — with notice, a human response and the right to appeal. The reputation you build stays yours.
home.manifestoBy: A promise from the Carbon Stealth team
home.ctaTitle: Speak to the whole world from one link.
home.faq1a: Linketto is a link in bio page: one link that gathers all your links, products and contacts. The unique part: your page speaks every visitor’s language — build it once and it shows in all 24 official EU languages.
home.faq2q: How is Linketto different from Linktree?
home.faq2a: Four things: your profile has versions in every language and shows each visitor their own automatically; it is hosted in the EU with GDPR by default; analytics are cookie-free with no personal data; and you get your own domain from the Pro plan (€4/mo). A detailed comparison with sources and date is on the “Linketto vs Linktree” page.
home.faq3a: The free plan is truly free — unlimited links and 2 language versions. Pro is €4/month (all languages, custom domain), Business is €9/month (up to 5 profiles), and Founder is a one-off €49 — Pro forever, up to 5 profiles. You pay once for 1, 3, 6 or 12 months — no subscription and no automatic charges.
home.faq4q: How does the multilingual profile work?
home.faq4a: Visitors automatically see your profile in their language (from their browser settings) or pick one on the page. You write in your language and the built-in AI translation fills in the rest with one click — your manual translations are never overwritten.
home.faq5q: Can I sell products from my page?
home.faq5a: Yes — you add a product with a price and your own payment link (Revolut, PayPal, Gumroad and others). The buyer pays you directly; Linketto does not stand between you and takes no commission. You are the seller and are responsible for the order, taxes and the buyer’s rights.

home.claimInvalid: Letters, numbers and hyphens only (up to 32 characters).
home.trustPayments: Plan payments via Revolut Bank UAB (a licensed EU bank)

legal.privacyBody:
Controller: Carbon Stealth VCC, Company ID (EIK) 208725180, VAT No. BG208725180, 3 Samuil St, 2670 Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, info@carbonstealth.eu.

In short: we collect only what the service needs; we never sell data; we use no advertising or tracking technologies; profile visitors receive no cookies; we keep data in the EU. Plan payments are processed by Revolut Bank UAB (Lithuania, EU) under its own policy, which allows transfers outside the EEA; other data leaves the EU only on your explicit action — to Google (AI translation and bio generation).

What we process and why · Account: email, hashed password, chosen language — to run the service (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, contract). Profile content: names, descriptions, links, images — published by you. Contact-form messages: name, email, text — delivered to the profile owner (Art. 6(1)(f), legitimate interest — communication you requested); kept for up to 12 months. Booking requests ("Booking" block): name, email, preferred time, message — delivered to the profile owner on the same basis; kept for up to 12 months. Plan payments: plan, period, amount, VAT, the Revolut order identifier, status (incl. a payment refunded in full) and the card and billing-address countries Revolut returns to us — to provide and suspend the plan (Art. 6(1)(b)), for VAT and accounting (Art. 6(1)(c) — the place of supply and the threshold under Art. 20b of the Bulgarian VAT Act) and to protect against abuse and legal claims (Art. 6(1)(f)); your card details never reach us, and your account email is passed to Revolut for the payment. Reminder before a paid period ends: an email 7 days and 1 day before (Art. 6(1)(b)). Referral programme: bonuses and withdrawal requests with the account you specified (IBAN/PayPal/Revolut) — to pay out bonuses (Art. 6(1)(b)), to protect against abuse and legal claims (Art. 6(1)(f)) and for accounting (Art. 6(1)(c)); kept while the account exists + 30 days, and accounting records as required by law. Invitations: if you sign up via an invite, we record who invited you — to run the programme for them and to prevent abuse (Art. 6(1)(f)); they see only the number of sign-ups and payments from their invites, not who you are. Analytics: cookie-free, no IPs, no personal data — we only count views and clicks (Art. 6(1)(f)). Weekly report: if you have a published profile, at most once a week we email you a summary — number of visits and your visitors' languages, with no personal data about them — based on legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) in keeping you informed about how your page performs; you can object at any time (Art. 21) — with one button from the link in any report or from your dashboard; the objection is honoured unconditionally. Import from Linktree: only on your action and only for your own public page, we fetch its public content (links, titles, bio, avatar) and add it to your profile (Art. 6(1)(b)); the avatar is re-encoded and EXIF data is removed. The free QR code generator runs entirely in your browser — nothing is sent to us. Withdrawal: if you withdraw from a paid plan, we keep your statement — name, the order, the date and time of receipt and when the acknowledgement was sent — together with the payment records, to process the withdrawal and be able to prove it (Art. 6(1)(c) and (f)). Notices and moderation (Regulation (EU) 2022/2065): we keep notices about profiles, our warnings and decisions, the category of breach and the reasons sent to the owner — to comply with the regulation and to defend appeals and legal claims (Art. 6(1)(c) and (f)); we keep them while the profile exists. Custom domain: the domain, a verification token and the verification date; we check the public TXT record in DNS (Art. 6(1)(b)). Clicks on products and links: counted without cookies, IP addresses or user agents — only with country, language and the site the visitor came from.

Sign-in security · When you sign in to your account we record the device's IP address and keep it for 90 days (Art. 6(1)(f), abuse protection). This never applies to profile visitors.

Recipients and transfers · Revolut Bank UAB (Lithuania, EU) processes plan payments as a payment service provider — for the payment itself, fraud checks and anti-money-laundering measures as an independent controller under its own policy (revolut.com/legal/privacy). The card details, name and address you enter on Revolut’s page are collected by Revolut — only the data listed above reaches us. Revolut may share data within its group and with the card schemes (Visa, Mastercard), including outside the EEA, under the safeguards in its policy. Google (Gemini API): only when you press "Translate with AI" or "Generate bio" yourself (including in the free bio tool without sign-up), we send the name, description or notes you entered (US transfer under DPF + SCC); the bio tool stores nothing on our side, and for its rate limit the IP address is kept only in server memory for up to 1 hour (Art. 6(1)(f), abuse prevention). Email: Sendinblue SAS (Brevo, France, EU) sends all transactional and newsletter emails on our behalf — solely to deliver them, as a processor under Art. 28 GDPR. An EU hosting provider. Beyond those — nobody. We never sell data or use it for advertising.

Retention · Account: while it exists + 30 days (if there are plan payments, the account is anonymised and the payment records are kept for 10 years). Contact-form messages and booking requests: 12 months. Newsletter subscribers: until unsubscribe — unsubscribing deletes the email; unconfirmed sign-ups: 30 days. Plan payment records: 10 years (accounting law). Analytics events: up to 13 months.

Your rights · Access, rectification, erasure, restriction (Art. 18), portability, objection (Art. 21) and withdrawal of consent at any time (Art. 7(3)) — write to info@carbonstealth.eu. You may lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP, www.cpdp.bg) or your local supervisory authority.

Automated decisions · When a plan payment is refunded in full, what it bought is removed automatically (the plan and period from before the payment are restored) and the referral programme bonus for that payment is reversed automatically. When a prepaid period ends without being extended, the account moves to the free plan automatically. These decisions are necessary for the performance of the contract (Art. 22(2)(a) GDPR). You can obtain human intervention on our part, express your point of view and contest the decision at info@carbonstealth.eu. We do not apply any other automated decisions.

Cookies · We use up to two strictly necessary cookies — linketto_session (httpOnly, to sign in to your account, up to 30 days) and NEXT_LOCALE (only when you choose a language yourself, up to 12 months). Details in the Cookie policy.

Newsletter · If you subscribe to a creator's newsletter, we process your email and language on the basis of your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) with double opt-in; the content is the creator's (the creator is the controller, Linketto the processor under Art. 28). We keep the data until you unsubscribe (every email has an unsubscribe link). All transactional and newsletter emails (confirmations, reminders before a paid period ends, newsletters, weekly reports) are sent via Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, EU).

Changes · We will notify you at your account email about material changes.
legal.termsBody:
Linketto is a service of Carbon Stealth VCC (Company ID (EIK) 208725180, VAT No. BG208725180, 3 Samuil St, 2670 Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, info@carbonstealth.eu).

Content and moderation · Illegal content, impersonation, phishing, malicious links, spam and misleading information are prohibited. Anyone can report a profile via the "Report" link on every public profile or at info@carbonstealth.eu (point of contact under Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 — DSA). We handle reports diligently and without arbitrariness. For a minor breach (e.g. spam) you first receive a warning with 7 days to fix it; for grave abuse (phishing, impersonation, illegal content) we may suspend the profile immediately. For every measure you receive by email, and see in your dashboard, a statement of reasons — what is restricted, for how long, why and on what ground — and you can appeal free of charge at info@carbonstealth.eu (appeals are reviewed by a human), complain to the Digital Services Coordinator or seek redress in court. We never show "BANNED" to your visitors.

Plans and payments · Paid plans are paid in advance, once, for a chosen period — 1, 3, 6 or 12 months — via Revolut (Revolut Bank UAB). There is no subscription and no automatic charge: we remind you by email 7 days and 1 day before the period ends, and if you do not extend, the account moves to the free plan and the paid features (custom domain, hidden badge, extra profiles and languages) stop. Extending the same plan is added to the end of the current period; when you move to a higher plan, the remaining days carry over pro rata by price. The Founder plan is a one-time payment with no payment end date — it applies for as long as Linketto is provided as a service; if we discontinue the service, we will notify you at least 90 days in advance. Prices are final, including 20% VAT. After every payment we send you a confirmation by email.

Right of withdrawal · If you are a consumer, you may withdraw from the contract for a paid plan (including an extension, a higher plan and Founder) within 14 days starting from the day after the payment (the conclusion of the contract), without giving any reason and at no cost. The plan starts immediately after payment; if you withdraw in time, we refund the full amount, with no deduction for the days used. Withdrawal removes only what that payment bought — the plan and period you had before it are restored. Withdraw with the “Withdraw from contract here” button in your dashboard (section “Plan”) or send us a clear statement at info@carbonstealth.eu — you may use the form below, but you do not have to; after withdrawing in the dashboard you immediately receive a confirmation by email; the deadline is met if you send your statement before it expires. We refund without undue delay and no later than 14 days from the day we receive your notice, using the same means of payment, at no cost to you.

Model withdrawal form — To: Carbon Stealth VCC, 3 Samuil St, 2670 Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, info@carbonstealth.eu. I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the provision of the following service: … / Ordered on: … / Name: … / Address: … / Account email: … / Signature (only if on paper) / Date: …

Refunded or disputed payment · If a plan payment is refunded in full, only what that payment bought is removed — the plan and period you had before it are restored (the free plan, if that earlier period has already ended). If you dispute a payment through your bank (chargeback), we may suspend the plan granted by it until the dispute is resolved.

Referral programme · Every account has a personal invite link; on profiles showing the “Create your free page” badge (mandatory on the free plan) it carries the profile owner's link. For the first payment for a paid plan made by a person who signed up through your link, you receive a bonus of {percent}% of the amount paid. A bonus is due only for a payment that has not been refunded in full and has not been successfully disputed through the bank. If such a payment is refunded in full or successfully disputed, the bonus is reversed, even if it has already been withdrawn; your balance may then become negative and the difference is deducted only from future bonuses — we do not require you to pay it to us separately, and it is waived when the account is closed. Withdrawal is possible once your balance reaches €{minPayout}. You are responsible for declaring the bonus as income. No bonus is due for sign-ups made by you or for fake accounts. If we suspect this, we review it manually, tell you the reasons, and you may object at info@carbonstealth.eu. An annulled bonus is deducted in the same way as a reversed bonus above.

Products · You can show products on your profile with a price and your own payment link (e.g. Revolut, PayPal, Gumroad). Linketto does not sell, accept payments, deliver or take a commission: the purchase contract, payment, delivery, taxes and the buyer’s rights (incl. the 14-day right of withdrawal where it applies) are entirely between you and the buyer. Next to each product we show whether you are a trader or a private individual — by your own declaration, so the buyer knows whether consumer rights apply; if you are a trader, you owe buyers the information and rights under consumer protection law. The price you enter must match the final price on your payment page (incl. VAT and all fees); if you are a trader, price reductions must follow the prior-price rules. You must not offer illegal goods or services or link to fraudulent payment pages.

Import · You import only your own content. By ticking “This is my page” you confirm that the page is yours and that you hold the rights to its content.

Liability · You are responsible for the content you publish and the products you offer. We are not liable for the content of external sites your links lead to.

Legal guarantee and disputes · As a consumer you have the statutory rights if the digital service is not in conformity (Directive (EU) 2019/770 and the Bulgarian law transposing it). For out-of-court dispute resolution you may turn to the Conciliation Commission for Consumer Disputes at the Bulgarian Commission for Consumer Protection (www.kzp.bg).

Governing law · Bulgarian law; Bulgarian courts have jurisdiction, without prejudice to mandatory consumer rights in your country.
legal.cookiesBody:
Linketto uses up to two strictly necessary cookies: linketto_session (httpOnly — to sign in to your account, up to 30 days) and NEXT_LOCALE — a functional cookie set only when you choose a language from the menu yourself, keeping your choice for up to 12 months. They do not track your behaviour and are never shared.

Visitors of public profiles receive no cookies at all. Our analytics are cookie-free: we count views and clicks without IP addresses, without user agents and without any personal data.

Because we use no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies, no consent banner is required (strictly necessary cookies — Art. 5(3) Directive 2002/58/EC; Art. 4a(4)(2) Bulgarian E-Commerce Act). Plan payments take place on Revolut’s page, which sets its own cookies under its own policy.

Questions: info@carbonstealth.eu.
